key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0560
name: poll_flag_bit_then_delay
description: Sets bit 1 of the shared flag byte, then calls a routine with the request value repeatedly while bit 4 of that byte stays clear. Once the loop exits it waits through a 15000-count delay and calls the routine once more with the request value.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:058E
name: delay_15000_then_call
description: Waits through a 15000-count delay routine and then calls the same routine again with the argument it received. It is a thin wrapper around the delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:05A8
name: step_position_to_target
description: Returns 0 at once if the position stored at offset 6 of the record already equals the requested value. Otherwise it toggles the side bit and the direction bit in the shared control byte, makes the required single-step calls with short and long delays, stores the new value, and returns the result of a final call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:05F6
name: step_frame_position_to_target
description: Performs the same side and direction handling and single-step loop as the position stepping routine, but takes its current and target values from the local frame and the record. It finishes by storing the requested value in the record and making a final call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0622
name: settle_then_step_frame_position
description: Sets bit 2 of the shared control byte and waits for a 200-count delay. It then moves the stepping position from its current value to the target value one step at a time, with a 15000-count delay, and stores the target in the record.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0666
name: step_difference_then_store
description: Sets the direction bit in the shared control byte, then steps the difference between two frame values one call at a time. It waits through a 15000-count delay and stores the requested value in the record before a final call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:069A
name: delay_then_store_position
description: Waits through a 15000-count delay, stores the requested value as a 16-bit number at offset 6 of the record, and passes the record to a called routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:06BE
name: merge_status_bytes_into_flags
description: Clears the bits of the shared flag byte that are set in the first parameter byte. It sets the top bit only when neither the top bit of the first byte nor the lowest bit of the second byte is set.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0700
name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Sets bits 3 to 6 of the shared control byte and leaves its other bits unchanged.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0718
name: spin_quarter_count_loop
description: Divides the requested count by four and calls a no-argument routine that many times as a timing loop. The called routine is a small stub that only removes a stack frame and returns a constant.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0740
name: set_bit0_then_delay
description: Sets bit 0 of the shared control byte, leaving its other bits unchanged, and then waits through a 3000-count delay routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:076C
name: start_disk_dma_and_wait
description: Points the disk DMA pointer at the buffer named in the record, clears the disk-block interrupt request, and starts a disk DMA transfer with a fixed length word when bit 2 of the shared byte is set. It then polls the interrupt request register for completion and returns 22 if that takes too long.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0800
name: poll_disk_status_timeout
description: Repeatedly reads a 16-bit field from the record and checks a status bit in a frame byte. When that bit is set it clears a field in the record and calls a routine; it returns 25 if bit 2 of the shared byte is clear, and 22 when its loop counter runs out.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:084C
name: set_record_flag_if_clear
description: Returns immediately when the flag byte at offset 1 of the record is already nonzero. Otherwise it sets that flag to 1, passes the record to a called routine twice, and waits through a 500000-count delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:085E
name: set_record_flag_unconditionally
description: Sets the flag byte at offset 1 of the record to 1 without checking it first. It passes the record to a called routine twice and then waits through a 500000-count delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:088A
name: clear_record_flag_if_set
description: Returns immediately when the flag byte at offset 1 of the record is zero. Otherwise it clears that flag and passes the record to a called routine twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:089C
name: clear_record_flag_and_notify
description: Clears the flag byte at offset 1 of the record and passes the record to a called routine twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:08BA
name: find_sector_sync_marker
description: Scans the buffer one 16-bit word at a time for the disk sync word and returns null when the buffer length is exhausted. When a second sync word follows the first, it returns the position two words before the match; otherwise it returns the position three words before it.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:08F4
name: back_up_pointer_three_words
description: Returns a pointer held in a frame slot moved back six bytes, which is the start of the sector header three words earlier. It is reached as the fall-through path of the sector search.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0900
name: scan_forward_for_sync_word
description: Advances a scan pointer one word at a time until it finds the disk sync word, and returns null once the end of the buffer is reached. When another sync word follows, it returns the position two words before the match; otherwise it returns the position three words before it.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:090C
name: encode_and_verify_track
description: Checks for the sync word at the expected position in the track buffer, writes the sync preamble in front of it, and encodes the sector header and data. It then checks each of the eleven sectors in turn, returning 22 when the sync word is missing, 23 when a sector start cannot be found, and 24 when a sector check disagrees.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0934
name: place_sync_and_encode_track
description: Writes the sync preamble four or six bytes before the first sector start, depending on whether the sync word follows immediately. It then encodes the header and data and checks the eleven sectors in order, returning 23 when no sector start is found and 24 when a check value disagrees.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:094C
name: encode_track_fixed_sync_offset
description: Writes the sync preamble six bytes before the sector start, encodes the header and data, and locates the next sector start. It then checks the eleven sectors in order, returning 23 when no sector start is found and 24 when a check value disagrees.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:09FC
name: verify_all_eleven_sectors
description: Clears the result field of the record, then for each of the eleven sectors it finds the sector buffer, runs the header check, and compares a checksum of the 1024 data bytes with the stored value. It returns the first header error code, 24 when the data checksum differs, and 0 when every sector passes.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0A88
name: verify_remaining_sectors
description: Advances the sector index before each check and stops after the eleventh sector. For each sector it runs the header check and compares the data checksum with the stored value, returning 24 on a mismatch and otherwise the last header result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0A90
name: return_stored_result_code
description: Returns the value held in the result slot of the frame without changing anything. It is a shared exit that the sector-check routines branch to.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0A98
name: locate_sector_buffer_address
description: Walks from the record current sector index toward the requested sector, moving the buffer pointer forward one sector slot at each step. It wraps the index after the tenth sector, switches to the alternate buffer pointer when the step count runs out, and returns the buffer address for the requested sector.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0ACC
name: advance_sector_buffer_pointer
description: Repeats the sector-slot step until the index counter reaches the requested sector, moving the buffer pointer forward one slot each time. It wraps the index after the tenth sector and switches to the alternate buffer pointer when the step count runs out.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B04
name: check_sector_header_fields
description: Checks the sync word and the header checksum of a sector, then compares its marker byte, track, sector number and sector count with the expected values. It returns 0 when every field matches and codes 4 to 8 for the first field that fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B1E
name: check_sector_header_from_frame
description: Performs the same sync, checksum and header field checks as the header check routine, reading the sector buffer and the expected header from the caller frame. It returns 0 when every field matches and the failing code otherwise.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B54
name: check_header_fields_only
description: Compares the marker byte, track, sector number and sector count of a header with the expected values, without checking the sync word or the checksum. It returns 0 when they all match and codes 5 to 8 for the first mismatch.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B68
name: check_track_sector_and_count
description: Compares the track, sector number and sector count of a header with the expected values. It returns 0 when they all match and codes 6 to 8 for the first field that fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B88
name: check_sector_number_and_count
description: Checks that the sector number is below eleven and that the sector count is nonzero and below twelve. It returns 0 when both pass and code 7 or 8 when one fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0B9E
name: check_sector_count_range
description: Returns 0 when the sector count byte of the header is nonzero and below twelve, and code 8 otherwise.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0BB8
name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Only returns 0 without touching any state. It is a stub that reports success.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0BBE
name: checksum_even_bits_of_longs
description: Computes a checksum by XORing together the long words of a buffer, with the byte length given by the caller, and keeps only the even-numbered bits of the result. The value is used to compare sector check values.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0BEA
name: mask_frame_value_even_bits
description: Returns a value from the caller frame with only its even-numbered bits kept and all other bits cleared.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0CF0
name: decode_interleaved_bit_longs
description: Merges two long words that each hold alternate bits of a value. It keeps the even-numbered bits of the second word, shifts the even-numbered bits of the first word up by one position, and returns the combined result, which matches the usual split used for disk sector fields.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0000
name: create_io_message_port
description: Creates an Exec message port through the system library call, stores the port pointer in the record, and sets the record size field to 56.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0024
name: delete_io_message_port
description: Deletes the Exec message port stored in the record, frees the 56-byte memory block that holds the record, and returns 0.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0054
name: read_disk_sectors_with_doio
description: Fills in a disk I/O request with the read command, a byte offset equal to the sector number times 512, a length equal to the sector count times 512, and an even-aligned buffer pointer. It then submits the request through the DoIO library call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:009A
name: write_disk_sectors_with_doio
description: Fills in a disk I/O request with the write command, a byte offset equal to the sector number times 512, a length equal to the sector count times 512, and an even-aligned buffer pointer. It then submits the request through the DoIO library call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:00E0
name: format_sectors_with_checks
description: Fills in a disk I/O request with the format command, a byte offset in 512-byte units and a length in 512-byte units. It runs two prerequisite calls and returns 1 or 2 when one of them reports a failure, and otherwise returns the result of the DoIO submission.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:012E
name: check_then_submit_io
description: Runs one check routine and returns 2 when it reports a failure. Otherwise it submits the request from the caller frame through the DoIO library call and returns that result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0144
name: submit_frame_io_request
description: Passes the I/O request from the caller frame to the DoIO library call and returns nothing.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0154
name: submit_disk_update_command
description: Clears the offset and length fields, sets the command code to 4, clears the flags byte, and submits the request through the DoIO library call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:0182
name: turn_disk_motor_off
description: Sets the command code to 9, the disk motor command, and clears the offset and length fields so the request carries zero length. It then submits the request through the DoIO library call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:4:01B0
name: issue_command_return_error
description: Sends a disk I/O request with the command code passed in by the caller, zero offset and zero length, through the DoIO library call. It returns the error field of the request.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:11:0000
name: allocate_named_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a cleared 34-byte message port structure through the Exec library. It fills in the name, priority, type and owning task, then either adds the port to the system port list or initialises its message list when no name is given. It returns the port, or 0 when the signal or the memory cannot be allocated.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:11:0032
name: allocate_port_after_signal
description: Continues port allocation after a signal bit has been obtained: it allocates the 34-byte port structure, frees the signal if that fails, and otherwise fills in the port fields. It then either adds the port to the system list or initialises its message list when no name is given.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:11:0060
name: fill_port_fields_and_add
description: Stores the name, priority, type and owning task into an already allocated port structure. It then either adds the port to the system port list or initialises its message list when no name is given.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:11:0094
name: initialise_port_message_list
description: Initialises the message list of the port structure passed in by calling the empty-list setup routine on its list field.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:11:00A8
name: remove_and_free_message_port
description: Removes the port from the system list when it has a name, marks its type field as invalid, frees its signal bit, and returns its 34-byte memory block.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:10:0000
name: initialise_empty_exec_list
description: Sets up an empty Exec list header at the address passed in: the head points to the tail slot, the tail is cleared, and the tail predecessor points back to the head.

name: pulse_drive_control_port
description: Writes the drive control port with bit 7 cleared and the other bits set, clears bit 3, makes two calls, then sets bits 3 and 7 again. It also stores a fixed flag value when a value read from the record is nonzero.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:00E0
name: decode_track_sectors_into_buffer
description: Scans the raw track for sync words and matches each sector header against the requested track. It decodes the sector data into the output buffer by combining alternate-bit longword pairs, retries up to ten mismatched headers before returning an error, and toggles the side bit in the control byte when the track is finished.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0184
name: find_track_sector_then_decode
description: Searches the raw track for the sector whose decoded track value matches the requested track, retrying up to ten times. Once a match is found it decodes that sector into the output buffer by combining alternate-bit longword pairs.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0196
name: decode_sector_longs_then_search
description: Decodes one sector of alternate-bit longword pairs from the raw track into the output buffer. When all eleven sectors are done it toggles the side bit and then searches for the next matching sector header, returning an error after ten failed matches.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:01FC
name: decode_both_track_sides
description: Sets the side bit and decodes the eleven sectors of a track, matching each sector header and retrying up to ten times. When the first side is finished it flips the side bit and decodes the other side.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0212
name: seek_head_to_byte_offset
description: Converts a byte offset into a track, a side and an offset within the track, using 5632 bytes per track. It sets the side bit in the drive control byte and steps the head one track at a time until the current track matches the target.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0238
name: seek_head_to_stored_track
description: Sets the side flag in the record to 255 and clears the side bit in the control byte. It calls a stub routine once, then steps the head one track at a time until the current track matches the target track stored in the record.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0260
name: step_head_until_track_matches
description: Steps the head one track at a time, in whichever direction is needed, until the current track equals the target track in the record. Each step calls two routines in turn.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:026C
name: poll_port_bit_then_clear
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while bit 4 of a hardware control byte stays set. It then clears a state byte in the frame before returning.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:026E
name: wait_until_port_bit_clear
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while bit 4 of a hardware control byte stays set, and returns once that bit reads clear. The loop checks the bit before the first call.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:027C
name: clear_direction_bit_and_step
description: Clears bit 1 of the shared control byte, which the stepping routines use as the direction, then calls a routine. It increments the track counter byte in the frame.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0288
name: step_back_set_direction
description: Sets bit 1 of the shared control byte, then calls a routine. It decrements the track counter byte in the frame.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0294
name: set_bit0_then_call_routine
description: Clears and then sets bit 0 of the shared control byte, so bit 0 ends up set with the other bits unchanged, and then calls a routine.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:02A0
name: program_port_registers_and_wait
description: Writes fixed values to several hardware port bytes, then waits until bit 0 of another port byte is set.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:02CE
name: start_disk_read_and_wait
description: Sets the DMA and disk control registers, writes the disk sync word, clears the disk-block interrupt request, and starts a disk read of a fixed length. It polls the interrupt request byte for completion with a bounded count, returning 0 when the transfer completes and minus one when the count runs out.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0328
name: stop_disk_dma
description: Writes the disk length register with the DMA-off value, clears the disk DMA enable bit in the control register, and returns 0.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc][a]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc][a].adf:bootblock:0:0338
name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Busy-waits while bit 5 of a hardware status byte at a fixed offset stays set, then returns.
